description: This file defines the EntityReferenceFieldNormalizer class for normalizing entity reference fields in Drupal's JSON:API module. It includes methods for normalizing fields, generating relationship links, and checking resource types.

classes.name: EntityReferenceFieldNormalizer
classes.description: Normalizer class for entity reference fields, handling normalization and relationship link generation.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes an entity reference field into JSON:API format, including relationship links.

methods.name: getRelationshipLinks
methods.description: Generates self and related links for a resource relationship.

methods.name: hasNonInternalResourceType
methods.description: Checks if a list of resource types contains any non-internal types.

methods.name: getSupportedTypes
methods.description: Returns supported field types for normalization.
